AWARENESS PROGRAM ON ANTI RAGGING 
Name of Activity : Anti-Ragging 
Need of the Activity : To educate the students in terms of ragging and its consequences 
 
The NSS Unit of S V College of Engineering has conducted the awareness programme on Anti-
Ragging by Mrs. Anju Yadav, C.I, Renigunta, to the all students’ community. Madam inspires a 
lot regarding healthy life style without involving any ragging activities in education life. And also 
explaining the consequences of ragging in all aspects wi th so many real life examples during her 
service.
